purpose: Freeze identical competitor-discovery queries and catchment membership rules for candidate and outside-audit nodes before national competitor evidence is inspected.

permitted_discovery_channel.description: General web search is a lead-generation channel only. Raw result pages and snippets are not retained or used as confirmation evidence.

query_templates.query_text_template: {place_name} MRT Singapore primary school maths tuition centre
{place_name} MRT Singapore secondary school maths tuition centre

execution_rule: Run both templates once for every unique frozen candidate, outside-audit or separately labelled strategic-benchmark node. Record zero, blocked and completed outcomes. Deduplicate physical branch leads across queries, but retain every query-to-lead link and every applicable target role.
validation_rule: Every unique lead receives a candidate-specific operator-controlled attempt for physical address, current operation, Mathematics offering and overlapping P1-S4 level. Search snippets, map pins, directories and legal-entity records cannot confirm a branch.

catchment_membership.walking_route_failure_rule: Keep network catchment membership unresolved; report 800 m and 1,200 m straight-line proximity separately and never relabel it as walking time.
catchment_membership.multi_node_rule: A validated physical branch may belong to multiple frozen node catchments; validate it once and retain every catchment membership.
